{{Quote|This war is killing me. My whole business is going down. Give me another round!|The Quarren discussing his situation in the tavern|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>}}
When [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] visited [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] in search of information, Ahsoka used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to listen on people's conversations, one of which was this '''unidentified Quarren''''s. He owned a business, and due to [[Clone Wars/Legends|the war]], it was doing poorly. When a fight broke out between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the patrons of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], this Quarren did not aim a blaster at them, although [[Unidentified Quarren (Moshi bar)|another of his kind]] did.
